command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: create datauser ==="
if ! id datauser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -d /home/datauser datauser
fi
id datauser

echo "=== STEP 2: create backing image for /srv/data ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/srv-data
IMG=/var/lib/srv-data/srv-data.img
if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then
  sudo -n dd if=/dev/zero of="$IMG" bs=1M count=512 status=none
  sudo -n mkfs.xfs -q "$IMG"
fi
ls -la "$IMG"

echo "=== STEP 3: mount point ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 4: fstab entry (idempotent) ==="
FSTAB_LINE="$IMG /srv/data xfs loop,uquota,usrquota 0 0"
if ! grep -qF "$IMG" /etc/fstab; then
  echo "$FSTAB_LINE" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi
cat /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP 5: mount (if not already mounted) ==="
if ! findmnt /srv/data >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n mount /srv/data
fi
findmnt -T /srv/data
mount | grep srv-data

echo "=== STEP 6: ownership ==="
sudo -n chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
ls -ld /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 7: enable/set xfs user quota limit 100MB for datauser ==="
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'limit bsoft=95m bhard=100m datauser' /srv/data
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -u -h' /srv/data

echo "=== VERIFY: enforcement test as datauser ==="
sudo -n -u datauser dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/data/testfile bs=1M count=150 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
ls -la /srv/data
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -u -h' /srv/data

echo "=== CLEANUP test file ==="
sudo -n -u datauser rm -f /srv/data/testfile
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c 'report -u -h' /srv/data
